description: This Java class 'ProgramWorkflowStateEditor' is a property editor used within the OpenMRS framework to serialize and deserialize 'ProgramWorkflowState' objects for web forms and other serialization mechanisms. It extends a generic 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' and overrides methods to retrieve state objects by ID or UUID using the 'ProgramWorkflowService'.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowStateEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing 'ProgramWorkflowState' objects within OpenMRS, enabling their use in web forms and other data exchange formats.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState object by its ID using the ProgramWorkflowService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState object by its UUID using the ProgramWorkflowService.
